name: Design System Inspired by Claude (Anthropic)
tagline: Warm terracotta accent, clean editorial layout — a literary salon reimagined as a product page.
description: Claude's interface is built on a parchment-toned canvas with warm, yellow-brown neutrals and organic illustrations. Terracotta brand accent, serif headlines, sans UI, and a ring-shadow depth system that avoids traditional drop shadows. Every detail evokes high-quality paper, not a digital surface.

logo.notes: Claude wordmark in Near Black (#141413). No logo file available — use Georgia serif wordmark as substitute.

colors.name: Parchment
colors.usage: Page canvas — warm cream evoking premium paper

voice.tone: Thoughtful and quiet. Like a magazine editor who also happens to build AI — every word is chosen with care, every surface feels considered. Never shouts.
messagingPillars: Thoughtful companion — the interface invites conversation, not command
Warmth as differentiation — parchment tones and terracotta say 'human' in a cold AI landscape
Editorial quality — pages paced like magazine features with serif-driven hierarchy

imagery.style: Organic, hand-drawn-feeling vector illustrations in terracotta, black, and muted green. Abstract and conceptual — not literal product diagrams.
subjects: Dark UI screenshots for contrast against warm canvas
imagery.treatment: Generous border-radius (16–32px) on media. Embedded media with rounded corners. No heavy drop shadows.

postureRules: Alternate light/dark sections — Parchment → Near Black → Parchment, like chapters in a book
Ring-shadow depth system: 0px 0px 0px 1px warm rings instead of drop shadows
Input focus uses Focus Blue (#3898ec) — the only cool color, for accessibility only
No cool neutrals — every border, fill, and shadow carries a yellow-brown undertone
Serif headings at weight 500 only — no bold, consistent editorial voice
